headline: Is he scared to commit, or just never going to?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see him, but your hand found the one who controls what is shown.
He stands openly behind a table he has arranged.
You asked whether he is scared to commit or never will. The deliberate presentation is what catches me.
He has not committed, and you have been left with two explanations for it.
There's something between what he presents and the commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me look at what's standing there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The card was hidden, yet you chose the calmest figure in the deck.
He hangs by one ankle. His face is calm.
You asked what is happening inside his pause. This card makes me look at the calm face.
Still, the future is held, and his reason is not available to you.
What has hold of the future holds it quietly. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the future…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs were alike, but your hand went to the one carrying almost nothing.
One small bundle is all he carries at the start.
You asked for a verdict on his fear and future. The lightly packed beginning holds my eye.
But commitment has not settled, and “never” has entered the question.
Something appears right where the beginning would need to become a decision. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
